entries.title: Feature Tracker roadmap goes live
entries.summary: You can now watch what we're building before it ships — every upcoming feature gets a status badge (Planned → In progress → Shipped) so you see the platform take shape live.
details: Author a real "Coming next" roadmap section on /changelog/: features get a
two-view entry (light public summary + precise dev details) and a lifecycle
status badge (planned → in-progress → shipped).
add-roadmap.mjs records agreed features BEFORE any implementation starts;
set-roadmap-status.mjs marks progress; bump-version.mjs promotes the matching
roadmap item into a released changelog entry (keeps summary/details).
AGENTS.md now documents the plan-first workflow so future sessions add the
roadmap entry before coding.

entries.title: Feature tracker + versioned changelog
entries.summary: GlobalFolkGames now ships a 'What's New' section — every release records a version number and a plain-language summary; your connected web3 wallet is recognized.
details: # Engineering notes for release <next>.md
# Append technical bullets (one per line, "- " or plain text) that the next
# `node scripts/bump-version.mjs` run will fold into the changelog entry as
# the ADMIN-only raw details. Keep secrets out. Test tables welcome.
Added a versioned changelog + Feature Tracker system.
scripts/bump-version.mjs reads the current version from package.json (single
numeric source), bumps major/minor/patch, prepends an entry to
public/changelog/changelog.json and clears docs/changelog/unreleased.md for
the next cycle.
Changelog entries carry a public `summary` plus admin-only `details` (folded
from unreleased.md) and a `git` ref (commit id + message).
Two pages built as Vite inputs: /changelog/ (user-facing summaries, always
readable) and /changelog/admin.html (raw engineer view). Both load the
standard Dynamic/JDynamic auth stack via /src/main.js.
Staff gating is web3-native: public/changelog/roles.json maps Solana wallets
to admin/moderator. render.js resolves the connected Dynamic wallet
(window.getDynamicSolanaWallet) and bounces non-staff on the admin page.
Global header now shows a "What's New" link (public/header.js) pointing to
/changelog/.
Seed data: public/changelog/changelog.json with real project milestones
v0.1.0 (Dynamic sign-in) through v0.7.0 (latency benchmark).
build-emitted pages verified: npm run build renders dist/changelog/index.html
and dist/changelog/admin.html green.

entries.title: Latency benchmark: ER is the playable path
entries.summary: Measured real dice-roll latency on devnet. MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollup handles dice at ~1.7s (gasless) vs ~4.8s for the paid base-chain queue — and board moves run on the ER at ~10-20ms, invisible to players.
details: built scripts/lab/bench-roll-comparison.mjs (LEG=base|er|web2|all) measuring send->VRF-result on real devnet transactions
ER VRF queue 5hBR57...: avg ~1.7s, p95 ~2.0s (devnet oracle callback dominates)
Base paid queue Cuj97...: avg ~4.8s, p95 ~5.1s — 2.8x slower than ER
Web2 local Math.random: 0.0ms (5000 samples) — the honest baseline row
root cause of earlier bench failure: rollOn passed sponsor as playerAuthority for a PDA keyed to a fresh keypair => ConstraintSeeds(2006); fixed by separating payer vs authority
client already uses the fast ER queue (src/gfg-dice-config.js:25) — no code change needed for the fast path
benchmarks.html added at /games/ludo-lab/benchmarks.html for the marketing/3-way comparison story
Solana mainnet NOW ~75ms avg response (Jonas Hahn, Solana Fdn DevRel, Aug 11 2026); FluxRPC YellowSockets is a base-layer RPC optimization only — does not speed ER rolls

entries.title: Anti-cheat architecture decided: chain-authoritative earn mode
entries.summary: Decided the Play-to-Earn version will validate every move on-chain (consensus-enforced, ~10-20ms), so cheaters can't fake wins or farm rewards. A separate 'Play for Fun' mode stays lightweight for casual players.
details: client-authoritative is a milk-the-sponsor risk once real rewards launch -> chain-authoritative for ALL state-changing moves in earn mode

pattern proven by live open-source projects: Magic UNO (every card play on ER, sub-10ms), DesiDash (every tap 8-18ms, batch commits), WhoRugUs (moves/tasks/votes as signed ER txs, VRF roles, PER for secrets), rock-paper-scissor official example
dice must stay ER VRF (~1.7s) — provability IS the product; hide it inside the existing 3.5s dice animation window
computer turns are just another signer; automation does not create a trust gap
two-version plan: fun (client authority, no financial impact) vs earn (on-chain authority, reward gated on on-chain state)
revert rule if felt latency >~2.5s p95: fall back to local AI rolls + keep ER only for proof roll + final record

entries.title: Sponsor relay: players never hold SOL
entries.summary: Signed in with email OTP (Dynamic) then the app sponsored the on-chain dice setup — the player's wallet holds zero SOL, proving the gasless onboarding works end to end.
details: api/delegate.mjs (Vercel fn) + scripts/relay-server.mjs (local :8787) run initialize+delegate on the player's behalf
idempotent via getDelegationStatus router check; retries account reads on flaky public RPC
fixed relay gotcha: PublicKey.equals() not === (owner comparison was silently false, causing re-delegate every time)
Vercel domain globalfolkgames.fun live; GFG_SPONSOR_KEYPAIR env set; node pin via engines + removed invalid vercel runtime

entries.title: Points, levels and the +100 proof-roll reward
entries.summary: Winning now pays +100 points, but only if your signed-in seat finished 1st AND you made at least one verifiable on-chain dice roll that match.
details: playerProfiles[color].isUser() gates the reward in win-detection.js together with getOnchainProofUsedThisMatch()/getLastProofRollSignature()

profiles.js awardGlobalPoints: optimistic header bump + point_transactions audit row + profile totals/level + device pending-award queue (gfg_pending_awards_<userId>) that resyncs if Supabase is unreachable
RLS fix was a one-time Supabase SQL script (auth.uid() is empty for Dynamic users) — intentionally OUT of repo; do NOT re-add
ludo award passes the on-chain proof-roll signature as match_id, tying the Supabase record to the verifiable roll; syncPendingPointAwards de-dupes by match_id
crowns/finish order survive reload via serializeWinState/hydrateWinState in persistence.js

entries.title: MagicBlock ER VRF proven end to end
entries.summary: The full flow works on devnet: init (sponsor pays) → delegate to Ephemeral Rollup → gasless rolls signed by a session key → VRF callback returns real dice → undelegate. Players pay nothing.
details: harness /tmp/opencode/er-test proved init->delegate->roll gasless (fee payer with 0 SOL)->VRF callback {roll1,roll2,seed}->undelegate
program upgraded + redeployed with delegate/commit/undelegate; IDL synced to src/gfg-dice-idl.json
client rewritten for ER (src/magicblock-vrf.js, src/gfg-dice-config.js)
PlayerDice account = 8B disc + 3 u8 + i64 (19 bytes); coder.accounts.decode throws -> manual byte parse
Account/board state is a delegated PDA — the 'space' lives on-chain while the ER hosts it

entries.title: Ludo playable against AI
entries.summary: Classic Ludo with a full local board: human vs 3 computer players, capture mechanics, safe boxes, double-six bonus turns and persistent progress.
details: board.js + physics.js + mechanics/{actions,paths,state} implement movement, capture, AI strategy, persistence
AI rolls/steps are deterministic-xs local; token selection uses 4 strategies (capture > release-on-6 > goal > furthest)

entries.title: Foundations: Dynamic wallet sign-in
entries.summary: Players sign in with an email one-time code (Dynamic) which mints a self-custody Solana wallet — no seed phrase, no extension, no SOL required.
details: Dynamic email OTP -> embedded Solana wallet (WaaS) -> session keys sign on-chain actions without popups
Supabase profiles/point_transactions as the backup store
header.js/profiles.js/refreshAuthHeader drive the points pill

roadmap.title: Changelog tabs + pagination
roadmap.summary: The What's New page gets three clean tabs (Planned · In progress · Shipped) so you can browse updates without endless scrolling — long lists split into numbered pages.
details: Changelog pages get 3 status tabs at the top: Planned / In progress / Shipped.
Clicking a tab filters the list; the current (v0.8.0) item lands under Shipped.
Tabs are flex-row with nowrap + horizontal scroll so they never wrap/break on
mobile single-line.
Pagination added to both /changelog/ and /changelog/admin.html: Prev / page
numbers / Next, per-status pagination (PAGE_SIZE=6) so long update lists break
into pages naturally instead of one endless scroll.
Admin (dev) view: the DEV Plan details list becomes an ordered list
(1. 2. 3. ...) for easy scanning, replacing bullet dots. Only affects the
admin page list rendering.

roadmap.title: Only user-safe updates appear publicly
roadmap.summary: What's New always shows the updates that matter to you — new features, fun additions and fixes you can enjoy, nothing else.
details: User-facing changelog contains no unfixed security/anti-exploit detail — not even behind a flag.
Unfixed security work is tracked outside every browser-served asset (private git only).
Nothing security-related enters changelog.json until a fix ships.
Once shipped, the fix is a normal, user-friendly changelog entry announcing it.
No hide-by-flag machinery — the bytes are simply not in the client payload.
